title: What Happens When You Crack Your Knuckles?
description:
What Happens When You Crack Your Knuckles?

Kawchuk GN, Fryer J, Jaremko JL, Zeng H, Rowe L, Thompson R. 'Real-Time Visualization of Joint Cavitation.' PLoS ONE 2015;10(4)

Full sources:
- Kawchuk GN, Fryer J, Jaremko JL, Zeng H, Rowe L, Thompson R. 'Real-Time Visualization of Joint Cavitation.' PLoS ONE 2015;10(4):e0119470 (doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0119470): real-time cine MRI showed the cracking sound coincides with rapid cavity INCEPTION in synovial fluid (tribonucleation), NOT collapse of a pre-existing bubble; the event lasts under 310 ms; the refractory period before a joint can crack again is about 20 minutes (Roston & Wheeler Haines 1947)
- deWeber K, Olszewski M, Ortolano R. 'Knuckle cracking and hand osteoarthritis.' J Am Board Fam Med 2011;24(2):169-74 (PMID 21383216): in 215 people, no correlation between habitual knuckle cracking and hand osteoarthritis
- Powers T, Kelsberg G, Safranek S. 'Clinical Inquiry: Does knuckle popping lead to arthritis?' J Fam Pract 2016;65(10):725-726 (PMID 27846331): habitual knuckle cracking over several decades is not associated with clinical or radiographic evidence of osteoarthritis

Not medical advice — sources linked for every claim.
Your body keeps score. #shorts
